modules.summary: Current read commands register validate, extract, list, show, targets, active-target, completed-work, scopes, summary, and links check.
Current mutation commands register init, update-status, update-stability, append-note, target mutations, completed-work, AC, evidence, trace, and add-requirement.
MCP tool schemas include required read and mutation tools, including update_stability.
updateStability implements dryRun-capable stability patching and returns written/warnings.
summarizeTarget returns counts, new work candidates, stability blockers/warnings, diagnostics summary, completed work, and target goal.
